rationale.approvals: Zero required approvals avoids an impossible self-approval requirement while the repository has one trusted maintainer. Increase after a distinct trusted reviewer exists.
rationale.linear_history: Merge commits are part of canonical NXS governance and closure evidence.
rationale.signed_commits: Current feature-branch commits are not uniformly signed; signing enforcement requires a separately certified migration.
rationale.bypass: Administrative bypass exists only for documented break-glass recovery and must not be used by the normal workflow.
